claim: Tongerlo abdijbier is brewed by Brouwerij Haacht in Boortmeerbeek since 1990, not at Tongerlo Abbey itself; the abbey's own brewing ended in WWI when German troops confiscated the copper kettles.
quote: het merk Tongerlo werd in 1990 verkocht aan Brouwerij Haacht ... brouwerij gestopt met brouwen toen de Duitse bezetter de koperen ketels in beslag nam

claim: Averbode abbey beer is bottled by Brewery Huyghe in Melle, but a draught house beer is brewed in a micro-brewery inside the abbey café 'Het Moment' and is only available on site.
quote: The bottled version is brewed at Brewery Huyghe in Melle but the draught house beer is brewed in the micro-brewery you can see inside the abbey café. The house beer is not available in bottles and can only be tasted here.

claim: Het Moment Averbode houses an abbey café with on-site micro-brewery, cheese factory, bakery and abbey shop selling beer, cheese, bread and gingerbread — only ~8 km from Westerlo.
quote: Old service buildings were given a new purpose: they now house an abbey café with in-house brewery, a cheese factory, a bakery and an abbey shop.

claim: Hertog Jan brewery is located in Arcen, Netherlands (not Belgium) and is owned by AB InBev since 1995 — too far for a Tongerlo day trip.
quote: In 1995 it became part of the international Interbrew (later InBev, now Anheuser–Busch InBev) group... renamed Hertog Jan Brouwerij in 1998.

claim: Westmalle Trappist abbey and brewery are not open to general public visitors except one annual open day; the brewery is at Antwerpsesteenweg 496, 2390 Malle, roughly 28 km from Westerlo (edge of the 30 km radius).
quote: the Westmalle Abbey and Brewery are not open to visitors, with the only exception being an annual open day

claim: Café Trappisten, directly opposite the Westmalle brewery gate at Antwerpsesteenweg 487, is open Monday–Sunday 10:00–24:00 and serves Extra, Dubbel, Tripel plus abbey cheese; seats up to 1,200 with a large terrace.
quote: Antwerpsesteenweg 487, Westmalle... open Monday through Sunday from 10:00 am to 12:00 am... can accommodate 1,200 people and has a large outdoor terrace

claim: Duvel Moortgat brewery tours run at the Puurs-Sint-Amands site (Breendonk-Dorp 58, 2870), with Saturday slots at 11:00 and 14:00 — but the location is ~44 km from Westerlo, outside the 30 km radius.
quote: Saturday: 11 AM and 2 PM ... Duration: 2 hours, Cost: €18 per person

claim: Distance from Puurs to Westerlo is 44 km straight-line / 65 km by road — confirming Duvel Moortgat is well beyond the 30 km radius.
quote: The distance between Puurs and Westerlo is 44 kilometers (27 miles), with the driving distance from Puurs to Westerlo being 65 kilometers (40 miles)

claim: Brouwerij Pirlot at Heistraat 3, 2240 Zandhoven brews the Kempisch Vuur range; visits are by appointment for groups of 15–30 at €10 pp for tour plus three tastings (smaller groups get a brewer's film at €7).
quote: Heistraat 3, 2240 Zandhoven... price for a short presentation, brewery tour, and tasting of three samples of different beers is €10 per person

claim: Brouwerij Leysen at Meivuurstraat 2, Herentals (Kempen) brews the Baskwadder blond/dubbel/tripel range; standard hours include Thursday 18:00–21:00 and weekend by appointment, with a Streketour stop on Sun 25 May 2026.
quote: Streketour... Sunday, May 25, 2026. Visitors can taste beers and spirits, tour the brewery and distillery

claim: Brouwerij Haacht in Boortmeerbeek runs guided tours Mon–Thu only for groups of 15–50 at €19 pp adult, ending with two drinks at Brasserie Brouwershof — but Boortmeerbeek is ~35 km south of Westerlo, just outside the 30 km radius.
quote: You can visit Haacht Brewery from Monday until Thursday... adults pay €19... two free drinks at Brasserie Brouwershof

claim: Lier holds a Saturday market on and around the Grote Markt every Saturday from 08:00 to 12:30 with fresh produce, flowers, textiles and leather — ~22 km from Westerlo.
quote: every Saturday on and around the Grand Place... operates between 8 and 12:30

claim: Westerlo's own weekly market runs on Wednesday (not Saturday/Sunday), so weekend visitors should head to Lier for a market experience.
Chocolaterie Lornoy at Zandstraat 64, Herentals is a Gault&Millau-listed artisanal chocolatier known for melocakes in twenty flavours, pralines and 'paardenkoppen' — ~12 km from Westerlo.
quote: Chocolaterie Lornoy... assortment of pralines, melocakes in twenty flavors, and small paardenkoppen

claim: Tongerlo Abbey's shop 'De Oude Linden' (restored grain barn) sells Tongerlo beer, abbey honey, jams and liqueurs, but unlike Averbode you cannot drink the beer inside the abbey walls.
quote: Unlike Averbode Abbey, you cannot taste the Tongerlo beer within the abbey walls

claim: Westerlo's tourism listing counts 31 cafés, 34 brasseries and 16 restaurants, including Alice Gastronomia (Grote Markt 26B) and Hotel Geerts (Grote Markt 50) on the central square; Torenhof sits in Tongerlo village.
quote: Brasserie (34)... Café (31)... Alice Gastronomia – Grote Markt 26 B, 2260 Westerlo
